plan.notes: Source: official Arcadia University "BS, Computer Science, Course Pathway" PDF (Math and CS Course Pathways), hosted at arcadia.edu, URL below. Degree name "Computer Science, B.S." verified in the official Arcadia catalog (catalog.arcadia.edu, Programs by Area, Computer Science and Mathematics department, College of Arts and Sciences). Transcription method: direct term-by-term transcription of the official pathway table as rendered; course codes, titles, and credit values copied verbatim (Arcadia courses are 4 credits each). The pathway's printed total is "TOTAL = 128 Credits" (16 credits x 8 semesters), which is used as total_credits. Catalog year caveat: the PDF is undated internally; it was uploaded to arcadia.edu in January 2024 (WP uploads path, search-index update dates), so the catalog cycle in effect at publication is labeled 2023-2024. If a later year-suffixed pathway variant is collected, it must use a distinct filename per the seed-merge rule. The pathway lists no prerequisite information, so all prereq arrays are intentionally empty (never invented). Year 3 carries the official note "OR Possible Study Abroad" as an option for either/both semesters; it is not a required course and is not modeled as a slot. The three 0-credit lab co-requisites (CS101L, CS202L, CS203L) are required and flagged required_zero. "AUC/ Elective" slots are student-choice: an Arcadia Undergraduate Curriculum (AUC) requirement or general elective. "200-Level CS Elective" (2) and "300-Level CS Elective" (1) are major-choice slots.
